title: Editing the Default Executive Insights App Role

blocks.text: The Executive Insights App admin role is one of the default roles Zscaler provides. It gives the admin the permissions and scope required to access the Executive Insights App, but not the Zscaler Admin Console. If you want to give an admin other permissions and functional scopes in the Zscaler Admin Console along with access to the Executive Insights App, you can create an admin role with Executive Insights App Access enabled, and then assign the new role to the admin.
To edit the Executive Insights App role:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Role Management > Internet & SaaS.
Click the Edit icon for the Executive Insights App role.
The Edit Administrator Role window appears.
In the Edit Administrator Role window, you can see and configure the following fields:
Name: The name of the admin role.
Enable Permissions for Executive Insights App: Gives the admin assigned this role the permissions and scope required to access the Executive Insights App. You can't modify this field.
User Names: Choose whether real user names are Visible or Obfuscated for admins with this role when they view data in the Executive Insights App.
Device Information: Choose whether device information is Visible or Obfuscated for admins with this role when they view data in the Executive Insights App.
Gen AI Prompt: Choose whether generative AI prompts are Visible or Obfuscated for admins with this role when they view data in the Executive Insights App.
Click Save and activate the change.
